steps.content: [WhiteSands Market]

A few hours ago
Marketplace, WhiteSands Region

The market is bustling with small stalls and crowded with people. Caravans passing through WhiteSands stop here to replenish supplies and gather information, while some merchants try to sell off surplus goods.
Blending into the crowd, a small group inconspicuously slipped into the marketplace.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Stay alert. The target is cunning. We need to gather as much intelligence as possible. We must not lose track of it.

steps.speaker: Legion Member
steps.content: ...Horo, is it okay to leave that MBCC girl alone in the car?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: It's really dangerous here. It's for her own good to leave her there. She'll understand.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: First things first. Let's move.
Horo gestures to the other Legion members, and they quietly throw on their cloaks, disappearing into the crowd.
The bustle of the market offers the Legion excellent cover, but... it's not quite as kind to the "little tail" trailing behind them.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Damn it, there are too many people here... How did Horo and the others disappear with just a few turns?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Did they find out I was tailing them and ditch me on purpose? No way...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Just trying to learn from you guys. It's not like I'll hold you back! Why do you have to keep me out?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...I'm not that useless. Seriously.
After struggling to navigate through the crowd, Hella finally finds a high vantage point. Standing on her tiptoes, she scans the crowd but finds no trace of her target.
Hella ruffles her hair in frustration, takes a deep breath and exhales loudly.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Who cares! I will definitely get stronger as long as I keep trying! Alright, I need some intel now. Hmm... crowded places are always good for intel...
There's a little stall nearby, where shabby parasols cast shade over a low table. Next to the table is a tall wooden board with a few wanted posters fluttering in the dry wind.
And the wanted individuals... are sitting and having a blast right under their own wanted posters.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Keep goin'... I just scored some <color=#fb9259>pricey goods</color>. My luck is on fire!
On the table, dice rattle happily inside wooden beer mugs. The wanted posters over their heads do not ruin the desert bandits' mood at all, playing cards and bragging about their haul loudly.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Goods? I remember Horo mentioned something about keeping an eye on some goods too...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hehe, I'll listen in for you...
She crouches low and carefully sneaks closer to the desert bandits, trying to catch snippets of their conversation. Luckily her tiptoeing goes unnoticed in this overly busy market.

To her disappointment, the bandits' conversations hold little substance—just talk of food, drinks, fun, and loot. There’s no mention of the "pricey goods" at all. Hella listens for so long that her legs nearly go numb, but she still learns nothing of importance.
—Until a figure brushes past Hella towards the desert bandits, and takes a seat at their table.
The sun shines on the hot ground, and a gentle breeze rustles the thick layers of wanted posters.
The woman removes her hat, locks eyes with the bandits, and speaks in a relaxed tone.
Playing a game? Can I join?
Dice, poker? Or how about something more thrilling...
A wanted poster is slapped onto the table—it’s the one of the desert bandit leader.
How about a <color=#fb9259>bounty game</color>?
Long time no see, old buddy. Pulled off some big heists recently? Your bounty's gone up quite a bit. Congrats...

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Bounty hunter... Korryn, this is not your place to talk.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: What, don't want to see me? Feeling scared? Don't want to play some cards? Or maybe...
The green lizard perched on the woman's rifle darts its eyes around.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Oh, I get it, you're afraid you can't even beat a little lizard, and that I'll send you back in, right?
Before she even finishes her words, the table is flipped over with great force. A desert bandit suddenly attacks, heading straight for Korryn!
...Bang!
The woman's movements too fast to follow. She doesn't even fire her rifle, but simply knocks the enemy to the ground with the butt of her gun.
Disregarding the glares of the other desert bandits, Korryn puts on her hat with panache and pulls out another wanted poster from her pocket to compare.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Wow, you're the one with the highest bounty. Looks like I'm in luck today...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: How about the rest of you? Wanna come at me all at once?

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Member
steps.content: Damn you, who the hell do you think you are?
Seeing their leader knocked to the ground, the other bandits grow furious and dash toward Korryn, but their fallen leader stops them.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: Wait a sec, why's my pocket so light? Something's wrong... where's my stuff?!
The "goods" are missing. The bandit leader glares at Korryn, but the bounty hunter shrugs innocently, as if to say it has nothing to do with her.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Member
steps.content: Boss, everything we robbed this morning is gone! The boxes we put there are gone too! Carajo... There's a thief! A thief!
The crowd of onlookers finally starts to stir. Everyone frantically checks their pockets to see if they've been picked.
And Hella, who has been watching the farce throughout, can't hold back her laughter any longer.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Pfft...!
It's too late to cover her mouth. Her snickering face is spotted by the bandits at the crime scene.
Their eyes meet, and Hella finally gets a good look at his face... It's the same old dumb desert bandit she tangled with the last time she came to WhiteSands!
The good news is, Hella is wearing a new outfit today to secretly follow Horo. Plus, it's been two years—he's probably long forgotten her.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Member
steps.content: Boss, this girl looks familiar... She's a cop from DisCity! Hey, was it you who stole our stuff?!
The bad news is, these desert bandits might be dumb, but their memory is sharp.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What cop? A cop in WhiteSands? You got the wrong person, bro!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I proudly serve Syndicate Legion Commander Horo—the shorty with the big axe! We're childhood buds! I knew her when she was just this tall!
As she speaks, she gestures to the height of her knees.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: ...Legion?
The crowd hesitates upon hearing that famous name. The Legion's reputation does work wonders, even outside Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: No, wait... Legion my ass! I recognize you!! You're that damn BBQ-C cop who beat us up two years ago!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Pff, hahahahah! BBQ-C...hahahah.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ahem, no, no... what BBQ? I really don't know what you're talking about, the Legion left a long time ago, we...

steps.speaker: Desert Bandit Leader
steps.content: You little vixen, still lying?! I'll break your leg!
Playing dumb didn't work. Time to run!
Without a second thought, Hella dashes off, not forgetting to flip a finger back at them.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So you want things the hard way, huh? I just wasn't in the mood to stir up trouble. It's not because I'm scared of you!
Passing a corner, Hella suddenly kicks over a nearby stall. The toppled wooden board forms a shield in the narrow passage.
The Rat Queen of Syndicate spins around and grabs a pipe, preparing to face the enemy.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Break my leg? Hah! I haven't been in the Syndicate all these years for nothing! I'll grow a new leg for every one you break! Come on, let's go one-on-one. Wonder how long you WhiteSands punks can last!
